scheme_name: Programme For Internship For LL.B./ LL.M./ Environmental Studies/ Research Students
other_conditions: The applicant must be a student pursuing three‑year or five‑year law degree courses in environmental studies or law from any recognized college, law school or university in India.
benefits_summary: Interns receive a certificate and an assigned guide during the 4‑week internship; no remuneration is provided.
